blocks.text: The slaughter intensifies, with blood reddening the earth and bodies covering the ground as horses, swords, arrows, and gunfire all combine in one crush of violence.
The Sikhs continue meeting every Turkish rush and ready themselves for shahidi without concern for bodily pain, even when the battlefield itself turns into carnage.
The page is dominated by martial excess: death is everywhere, but the Singh resolve does not break.
